label: SYNTHETIC RESEARCH DOCUMENT. NOT AN OFFICIAL AARHUS UNIVERSITY POLICY. All rules, amounts and dates are fictional.
source: Fictional meeting decisions of the Demonstration Finance Office.

entries.question: Can I take a taxi on an official trip when a bus or train would also work?
entries.answer: Yes. A work-related taxi is reimbursed when you attach the receipt.

entries.question: What is the most I can spend on a hotel night in Denmark?
I paid with my own card. Can I still get the money back?
entries.answer: Yes. Include the expense in your settlement; the university card is preferred, but a personal card is reimbursed.

entries.question: My train arrives at 00:30 and buses still run. Can I take a taxi home without approval?
entries.answer: No. Buses are running, so the taxi needs prior approval from the budget holder.

entries.question: I lost a receipt. Can the expense still be reimbursed?
entries.answer: No. Every expense needs a receipt.

entries.question: How long do I have to submit my travel settlement?
entries.answer: 30 days after the trip ends. After that, the budget holder must approve it.

entries.question: Has the hotel limit in Denmark gone up?
entries.answer: Yes. From 1 September 2025 the limit is DKK 1,350 per night, including breakfast.
